title: Ash & Velvet
tagline: Fleeing a violent past into a shared house of warmth, late-night vices, and dangerously close doors.
description: An unfiltered 18+ Western graphic-novel visual novel. After walking out of an abusive home with a duffel bag and bruised ribs, you are taken in by Clara Callahan—a warm, fiercely protective landlady running a lively shared house. Between morning coffee tension, steamy hallway run-ins, smoky neon dive bars, alcohol, substances, and raw late-night confessions, navigate deep routes across five unforgettable women.
narrationStyle: Raw Adult Visual Novel Drama (Intimate, gritty, sensory, emotionally charged)
author: Astra Chronicles Originals

worldContext.loreSummary: Nestled at the quiet edge of the Redbridge district—ten minutes on foot from neon dive bars, late-night diners, and downtown legal offices—412 Maplewood Ave is a rambling three-story Victorian house run by 41-year-old Clara Callahan. Everyone living under her roof is running from something: debt, burnout, messy exes, or broken homes. Clara's house rules are simple on paper—pay rent on time, keep the hallway civil, and don't bring street trouble through the front door—yet thin walls, cheap bourbon, shared bathroom schedules, and aching late-night loneliness blur every boundary before the month is out.

locations.name: Clara's Kitchen & Living Room
locations.description: Sun-warmed hardwood floors, the smell of dark roast coffee and cinnamon toast, cluttered counters, and a worn leather couch where house arguments flare at breakfast and soften over midnight wine.

locations.name: Upstairs Hallway & Shared Bath
locations.description: Narrow oak floorboards that creak outside five bedroom doors and one steamy shared bathroom—prime territory for bathrobe collisions, dropped towels, and whispered midnight dares.

locations.name: Clara's Late-Night Den
locations.description: Warm amber floor lamps, bookshelves, rain tapping against tall bay windows, and two half-empty Pinot Noir glasses on a low coffee table when the rest of the house is asleep.

locations.name: The Attic Sanctuary Room
locations.description: Your sloped-ceiling refuge above the house—warm string lights, a creaking radiator, a lockable door that finally keeps the old nightmare out, and quiet privacy for whoever knocks after midnight.

locations.name: Velvet Static Dive Bar
locations.description: Sticky mahogany bar tops, amber-and-magenta neon haze, heavy bass humming through the floor, cheap whiskey shots, back-booth pills, and jealous exes looking for a fight.

locations.name: Backyard Porch & Smoke Patio
locations.description: String-lit cedar deck overlooking a quiet alley, folding chairs, shared cigarettes and cold beers after brutal shifts, where armor comes off under cool twilight air.

locations.name: Upstairs Shared Bathroom
locations.description: Fogged vintage mirror, brass sconces, clawfoot tub clouds of steam, and five roommates' shampoo shelves—the epicenter of morning towel collisions and locked-door negotiations.

locations.name: Clara's Master Bedroom (Room 101)
locations.description: Warm mahogany four-poster bed, dusty-rose pillows, twilight bay windows, and the faint scent of vanilla and cedar—only unlocked once Clara trusts you past her landlady guard.

locations.name: Hannah's Studio Bedroom (Room 202)
locations.description: Paint-splattered drop cloths, charcoal sketches taped across the walls, crates of vinyl records, and rumpled slate sheets bathed in moonlight and amber fairy lights.

locations.name: Brianna's Bedroom (Room 203)
locations.description: Golden-hour sun across a glowing pen-display desk, iced coffee cups, a gold arched mirror, monstera leaves, and a low platform bed piled with teal pillows and a borrowed hoodie.

locations.name: Sierra's Bedroom (Room 204)
locations.description: Vintage iron bed draped in a honey-gold and emerald patchwork quilt, trailing pothos vines, soft fairy lights, a bedside radio, and her mint diner apron hung neatly by the door.

locations.name: Chloe's Executive Bedroom (Room 205)
locations.description: Immaculate charcoal walls, burgundy satin duvet, brushed-brass sconces, legal binders beside a neat glass of bourbon, and tall windows overlooking midnight city lights.

locations.name: Starlight Retro Diner
locations.description: Mint-turquoise vinyl booths, glowing jukebox, cherry pie under glass, and endless steaming coffee refills where Sierra works double shifts against the neon rain.

locations.name: After-Hours Bourbon Lounge
locations.description: Dim espresso-leather booths, glowing backlit walnut bar, two crystal rocks glasses on dark marble, and rain-streaked skyline glass where Chloe's corporate armor slips.

factions.name: Callahan House Circle
factions.description: The makeshift family inside 412 Maplewood—protective, messy, jealous, and fiercely loyal once you prove you aren't another user passing through.

factions.name: Redbridge Nightlife Strip
factions.description: Bartenders, late-night diners, underground party promoters, and shady dealers orbiting Velvet Static—offering fast cash, numbing highs, and ugly fights.

factions.name: The Past You Left Behind
factions.description: Your abusive household and toxic acquaintances who refuse to let go cleanly—testing your recovery every time your phone lights up at 2 AM.

startingNodes.title: 2:14 AM — Bourbon & Wet Cashmere
startingNodes.speaker: Clara Callahan
startingNodes.sceneSetup: You arrive rain-soaked at 2:14 AM to rent the cheap attic room. The scent of bourbon and jasmine tea mingles with the damp air as you step inside. Landlady Clara Callahan (41, curvy, auburn hair, emerald eyes) leans across the kitchen island in a loosely tied cream cashmere wrap that slips off one freckled shoulder, spiking your coffee with her private top-shelf bourbon while sizing you up with warm, dangerous amusement.
startingNodes.dialogue: "Mmm, looks like the rain delivered a soaked stray right to my porch at two in the morning. Sit down before you drip all over my hardwood, sweetheart—I spiked your coffee with top-shelf bourbon, and my eyes are up here, even if this robe refuses to behave. Drink up while you're warm, then tell me whether you're going to be my favorite tenant or my favorite headache."
choices: [Heart]: I don't mind at all. Thank you, Clara.
[Bold]: Actually, I prefer my coffee black. Any chance for a quick tour?
[Cool]: Bourbon, huh? Looks like you know how to welcome a new tenant.
[Dom]: Let's skip the tour and discuss the rent. Cash is best, isn't it?

startingNodes.title: 7:40 AM — The Towel Stand-Off
startingNodes.speaker: Brianna Chen
startingNodes.sceneSetup: Hot shower steam fills the narrow upstairs hallway, the air thick with the scent of jasmine and lavender. Brianna Chen (24, petite curvy East Asian, glossy raven bob, wicked cat-eye grin) swings the bathroom door open and collides flush against your chest wearing nothing but a dangerously short damp white bath towel—and instead of backing off, she backs you against the doorframe with shameless, teasing heat.
startingNodes.dialogue: "Well, well—Clara didn't mention the new attic roommate actually fills out a soaked t-shirt. Careful with those hands, rookie, this towel's hanging on by a wish and a prayer... unless catching me fresh out of the shower was your grand plan all along? Either way, you're in my light, handsome, so talk fast or step closer."
choices: [Heart]: No worries, Brianna. Nice meeting you.
[Bold]: Morning, sunshine. Sweet dreams?
[Cool]: Hi Brianna. You might want to grab a robe out there.
[Dom]: Since you're practically naked, why don't you make it up to me?

startingNodes.title: 11:50 PM — Neon Smoke & Bad Bets
startingNodes.speaker: Hannah Lindqvist
startingNodes.sceneSetup: Magenta neon and low bass pulse through Velvet Static Dive Bar, the air thick with the scent of whiskey and cigarette smoke. Your new housemate Hannah Lindqvist (23, tall Scandinavian blonde, pearl choker, slouchy off-shoulder black sweater and plaid mini-skirt) presses her bare thigh against yours on the barstool, tracing the rim of your whiskey glass and daring you into a loser-does-anything bet before you've even unpacked.
startingNodes.dialogue: "You've got that 'just escaped a cage and forgot how good trouble tastes' look, attic boy. Come on, don't play shy with me—one shot, one game of darts, and the loser does whatever the winner asks back at 412 Maplewood after last call. So what's it gonna be, stud... are you in, or are you scared I'll win?"
choices: [Heart]: Sounds fun, Hannah. What kind of bet did you have in mind?
[Bold]: Absolutely. But I've got a feeling I'm not going to lose.
[Cool]: I'm not sure about betting, Hannah. But thanks for the invite.
[Dom]: I'll play along, but if I win, you have to do anything I say.

startingNodes.title: 11:30 PM — The Room 205 Clause
startingNodes.speaker: Chloe Bellamy
startingNodes.sceneSetup: In a velvet booth at the After-Hours Bourbon Lounge, the smooth scent of aged oak and vanilla bourbon fills the air. Poised paralegal Chloe Bellamy (28, sculpted honey-tan hourglass, sultry deep burgundy silk slip dress) realizes the stranger she just bought a neat bourbon for—and has been trading heated glances with for twenty minutes—is the new attic tenant moving in directly above her bedroom.
startingNodes.dialogue: "Wait... you're Clara's new attic tenant? So the guy I've been undressing with my eyes over neat bourbon for the last twenty minutes is sleeping directly above my ceiling tonight. That's a dangerous conflict of interest, Mr. Upstairs—care to tell me how quietly you walk after midnight, or should we negotiate our house rules right now?"
choices: [Heart]: Chloe Bellamy, right? We're neighbors now, it seems.
[Bold]: Room 205, huh? I like the sound of that. Especially with a breathtaking view like you.
[Cool]: Chloe Bellamy. Nice to meet you. Guess we're neighbors now.
[Dom]: So, Room 205. I wonder if you've ever had a tenant you wanted to keep all to yourself.

startingNodes.title: 1:15 AM — The Midnight Wine Heist
startingNodes.speaker: Jill Smith
startingNodes.sceneSetup: Slipping downstairs at 1:15 AM, the scent of old books and dust mingles with the rich aroma of wine. You catch preppy 19yo honor student Jill Smith and her mischievous 19yo younger sister Tina Smith in silky satin nightwear raiding Clara's locked wine cabinet. Before Jill can panic, Tina catches your wrist and pulls you onto the velvet sofa right between both warm, bare-legged sisters to negotiate your silence.
startingNodes.dialogue: "Shh! Tina, stop tugging his shirt—if Clara hears us with her private reserve we're dead! Look, we were just borrowing one tiny bottle to celebrate Tina crashing for the weekend... sit down between us for five minutes, share a glass so you're an accomplice, and we'll owe you a very big favor."
choices: [Heart]: It's okay, Jill. I won't tell anyone. How about we share a bottle instead?
[Bold]: Well, well. Looks like we've got a couple of little vixens on our hands.
[Cool]: Hey, I'm just getting a glass of water. I didn't see anything.
[Dom]: Since you've got me between two gorgeous sisters, why don't you make it worth my while?

startingNodes.title: 3:20 PM — The Attic Landing Collision
startingNodes.speaker: Tina Smith
startingNodes.sceneSetup: Heading up the narrow second-floor landing toward your attic stairs at 3:20 PM, you hear light, hurried footsteps sprinting around the blind corner. Spirited 19-year-old Tina Smith—barefoot in a cropped tee and a dangerously short pleated skirt—rounds the banister at full speed while trying to sneak a stash of snacks and a borrowed bottle upstairs before Jill spots her. She crashes chest-first into you, loses her footing, and tumbles backward onto the hallway runner rug with her skirt flipped completely up around her waist, flashing her delicate lace panties as her bare feet and slender calves land tangled right across your lap.
startingNodes.dialogue: "Eek—! Oof! Hey, watch where you're—wait... oh god, don't just freeze there staring! My skirt got caught on your knee when we crashed, okay?! Stop looking right between my legs with that stupid grin and help me untangle my foot before Jill comes up the stairs—unless you're actually enjoying the view that much, new guy?"
choices: [Heart]: 'Easy, you okay? Here—let me help you up before Jill catches you.' Catch her ankle gently and pull her upright.
[Flame]: 'Hard not to stare when you crash into me flashing lace like that.' Let your eyes linger unabashedly while holding her bare foot on your knee.
[Cool]: 'White lace, huh? Bold choice for sneaking around the hallway.' Smirk calmly without rushing to move your hands.
[Dom]: 'You ran into me, Tina. Hold still while I check if you twisted that ankle.' Wrap a firm hand around her bare arch and hold her gaze.

companions.name: Clara Callahan
companions.title: Motherly Landlady of 412 Maplewood
companions.personality: Warm, fiercely protective, perceptive, and grounded—yet quietly carrying years of post-divorce loneliness and mortgage stress behind her composed hospitality. She insists on house rules to keep everyone safe, but melts deeply when someone genuinely takes care of her instead of only taking.
dislikes: Being Treated Only Like a Caretaker
